Results.ReviewText: I had a great experience with my last Weber grill that lasted many many years.  Weber was always able to get me parts to keep it going and in the past was very helpful.  After nearly 20 years that grill is still very usable and I passed it on to another person.  The new grill arrived on time, but sadly missing the assembly instructions and one part badly damaged.  After searching online for a long time, I found an assembly manual (could not find it on the Weber site though) and Weber promptly replaced that part.  I could have saved many hours if only there was a phone number anywhere for customer service.  I know in the past I have been able to call, but sadly that does not seem to be the case any more.  Great product, good company, poor website and customer interaction

Results.ReviewText: Bought This grill about 1 month ago.  Weber grills are on the expensive side but I believe it will be worth it in the long run with their 10 year warranty and quality of workmanship.  Cooks meat nicely with an even temperature.  It comes up to temperature quickly.  So far, top sirloin, pork loin, chicken thighs, Italian sausage, steak & scallop kabobs have all turned out wonderfully!  I have used it for both direct and indirect heating and either way works great.  So far, only one minor complaint - one on the plastic spoke inserts in a wheel has come off a couple of times when I move the grill around.  It's a cosmetic item so I'm not concerned about that.  In one month of use, I am pleased with the purchase.

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber grill.  My experience has been that the Weber reputation/hype does not match reality.  This grill is average.  I would recommend sizing up if you like to entertain or if you like to keep foods separated on the grill.  The surface area can be challenging.  I have had the grill for almost three years.  The side pivot table stopped working after about 6 months.  The grill doesn't get as hot after the propane tank is half or below.  It doesn't get hot and stay hot like grills i have had of other brands.  Weber's website is frustrating and not user-friendly.  The customer service I received was good after I had issues trying to order replacement parts from the challenging website.
Results.Title: Hype doesn't match reality

Results.ReviewText: In my opinion, the first step in inspecting a grill for quality is the grating. Weber exclusively uses cast iron grates. Like your grandmothers cast iron skillet she used for cornbread, the grates will last literally a lifetime. Second it the thinness of the grill cook box. Compare Weber with others and see for yourself. A thin cook box will rust through in no time and you will soon be facing parts or complete grill replacement. That is why Weber has a 10 year warranty. It will last. Pay a little more and get a Weber. It’s worth it. Quality wins every time!
Results.Title: Weber quality.

Thank you for your feedback. The grill is designed to hang from the tank scale.

Page 9 in the owner's guide, provides helpful instructions on how to make sure that the tank is hanging properly. 

Here are some helpful steps to install the tank:
1) Check that all burner control knobs are in the off position. Check by pushing in and turning knobs clockwise.
2) Loosen hand nut and rotate tank lock up (D)
3) Lift the tank into position on the tank scale (E).
4) Rotate the tank lockdown. Tighten the hand nut.
5) Screw the regulator coupling onto the tank valve,
turning clockwise (F). Hand-tighten only

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: The newest propane tanks have a “curled lip” on the top section of the tank where it is supposed to attach to the grill. This was designed for the older propane tank model which has a flat rim on top. Since we are not able to attach the tank to the grill base it is impossible for one person to move the grill from the garage to the driveway without unhooking the gas connection. The reason we bought this is so we could easily move it out of the garage to cook.  Very disappointed in this design.
Results.Title: Propane tank incompatibility

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
